news.title: Shenkar showcases next generation of Israeli fashion at Tel Aviv Fashion Week
news.summary: “This year, we chose to invite the audience into the design process itself, rather than simply presenting the final result,” said Ilan Beja, head of Shenkar’s Department of Fashion Design.

news.title: Katz: Caretaker gov't fully responsible for Israel's security, taking actions against terror groups
news.summary: Katz's statement follows a letter from Yashar's Eisenkot calling on PM Netanyahu to exercise greater caution and responsibility in security and national decisions until a new government is formed.

news.title: Maccabi Tel Aviv captain leads dramatic comeback against Hapoel to lift Winner Cup trophy
news.summary: Down 23 points in the third quarter, Maccabi Tel Aviv basketball staged a stunning 86-75 comeback win over Hapoel, led by captain John DiBartolomeo despite scoring no points.

news.title: France bars Samaria Regional Council head Yossi Dagan from entering country - exclusive
news.summary: The decision marks an unusual move by French authorities, as there have been no previously known cases of France imposing an entry ban on a West Bank regional council head.

news.title: Majority of students think teachers aren't adequately preparing them for future, new study shows
news.summary: Following several years of war, the study also found that 43% of students believe that security, cybersecurity, and intelligence studies should be added to the standard curriculum.
